;'''brivla'''
:a ''verb'', any word that can state a relationship among several objects or concepts, and thus be the core word in a Lojban '''[[bridi]]'''. Can be converted to ''[[noun]]'' be prefixing with '''lo''' or similar articles.
:a predicate word
<noinclude>
'''brivla''' are in the main [[gismu|gismu]], [[lujvo|lujvo]] and [[fu'ivla|fu'ivla]]. A few [[cmavo|cmavo]] can behave as [[brivla|brivla]]. [[cmevla]] also belong to brivla but almost never used for [[selbri]].
</noinclude>
